name: m365-attachment-reader-mcp-local
description: Read Outlook email attachments and send local files (e.g. PPTX) as Outlook attachments locally inside Claude Desktop using Microsoft Graph.
long_description: A local single-user MCP server for Claude Desktop that authenticates to Microsoft 365 using device code flow, lists Outlook messages and attachments, and parses attachment content including OCR-scanned PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, archives, and Outlook MSG files. It can also compose an Outlook email with local files attached (such as a daily dashboard .pptx) and either save it as a draft for review or send it immediately.

m365_client_id.title: Microsoft Entra App Client ID
m365_client_id.description: Application (client) ID from your Microsoft Entra app registration.

m365_tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
m365_tenant_id.description: Optional Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Use common for most personal or multi-tenant setups.

m365_auto_open_browser.title: Auto-open browser
m365_auto_open_browser.description: If enabled, begin_auth will try to open the Microsoft login page automatically.

m365_send_max_bytes.title: Max outbound attachment size (bytes)
m365_send_max_bytes.description: Optional total size budget for send_outlook_email attachments. Defaults to 3 MB; must stay under Microsoft Graph's ~4 MB request limit. Leave blank to use the default.

m365_send_allowed_dirs.title: Allowed attachment directories
m365_send_allowed_dirs.description: Optional OS-path-separated list of base directories that send_outlook_email may read files from. Leave blank to allow any readable path.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check whether the local Outlook attachment MCP server is running.

tools.name: begin_auth
tools.description: Start Microsoft 365 device-code login for the local MCP server.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check whether Microsoft 365 login has completed.

tools.name: list_recent_messages
tools.description: List recent Outlook emails. Each result includes a messageId to pass to read_email or reply_outlook_email.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Full-text search Outlook mail. Each hit includes a messageId for read_email and reply_outlook_email.

tools.name: list_flagged_messages
tools.description: List flagged Outlook emails, each with a messageId for read_email and reply_outlook_email.

tools.name: list_email_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a specific Outlook email by messageId.

tools.name: read_email_attachment
tools.description: Download and parse an Outlook attachment, including OCR and image-based formats.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read one Outlook email by messageId. After reading, reply in-thread with reply_outlook_email using the same messageId.

tools.name: read_email_body_chunk
tools.description: Read an Outlook email's message body in offset-based slices, for emails whose body was cut off by read_email's character limit.

tools.name: send_outlook_email
tools.description: Compose a new Outlook email with local file attachments (e.g. a .pptx) and save it as a draft or send it immediately. Starts a new conversation.

tools.name: reply_outlook_email
tools.description: Reply in the same Outlook thread. Pass the messageId from list/search/read. Saves a draft by default, or sends immediately.
